decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the battlefield through counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes while generating card advantage and card selection to outvalue opponent. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion for additional card advantage. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana base and utility lands for additional advantage. Teferi, Hero of Dominaria acts as a win condition by generating card advantage and providing control over opponent's plays. Shark Typhoon can create a threat while also generating card advantage. Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea provide additional card selection and advantage.

This deck focuses on using sacrifice effects and aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Witch's Oven, Claim the Firstborn, and Mayhem Devil to generate value from sacrificing creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional mana acceleration. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the game. Overall, the goal is to create a board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately leading to a quick and decisive victory.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to slow down the opponent's game plan through counter spells, removal, and card advantage engines like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants, while also generating value and reaching the late game with cards like Rewind and Memory Deluge. The inclusion of a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, adds another layer of synergy and consistency to the deck.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a combo using cards like Torrential Gearhulk and Indomitable Creativity to create powerful and unexpected plays. It also utilizes versatility and control through cards such as Fiery Impulse, Prismari Command, and Sublime Epiphany to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its creativity and explosive plays, while also having answers to various threats through cards like Stormcarved Coast and Make Disappear. By combining different elements of control, combo, and creativity, the deck seeks to dominate the battlefield and outmaneuver opponents.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with green devotion creatures and enchantments like Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Wolfwillow Haven. By generating large amounts of mana, you can easily cast threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional synergy and utility. Storm the Festival helps you search for key creatures, while Boseiju, Who Endures protects your important spells. Lair of the Hydra is a powerful finisher in the late game.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using green creatures and enchantments, with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx as a key piece for generating additional green mana. The deck aims to play big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn early on, supported by Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner for additional card draw and ramp. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage, making this deck a potent Aggro deck with a strong devotion to Green.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures with lifelink and flying abilities to pressure opponents while gaining life to stay ahead in the game. Utilizing cards like Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie alongside support cards like Bishop of Wings and Giada, Font of Hope, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures and life gain synergies. With a strong mana base and the ability to generate extra mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and close out games efficiently.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence by enchanting creatures with powerful Auras to deal damage and draw cards. The key strategy involves playing multiple Auras on a single creature to maximize its effectiveness and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ethereal Armor, All That Glitters, and Staggering Insight, the deck aims to create a fast-paced and aggressive gameplay style that can quickly take down opponents before they have a chance to respond effectively.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by burn spells and pump effects. By playing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Kari Zev, and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with powerful pump effects like Atarka's Command and Reckless Bushwhacker, the deck aims to apply pressure early and often. Additionally, cards like Play with Fire and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide direct damage to either control the board or finish off the opponent. The deck's mana base supports its aggressive strategy by providing consistent access to its spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up with mana acceleration creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, while also generating additional mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven. The deck focuses on green devotion and aggressive plays, utilizing powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to control the board. Cityscape Leveler and Invasion of Ixalan provide additional win conditions for the deck.

The key strategy of this deck is to quickly flood the board with low-cost creatures like Thraben Inspector, Ornithopter, and Venerated Loxodon, then use anthem effects from cards like Clarion Spirit and Resolute Reinforcements to pump them up and overwhelm the opponent. Reckless Bushwhacker and Castle Embereth also provide additional sources of damage, while Giant Killer offers removal options. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds a consistent source of mana acceleration to keep the pressure on the opponent. Gleeful Demolition can also provide a powerful finisher when needed.

This deck focuses on using the card Indomitable Creativity to transform cheap artifacts into powerful creatures or planeswalkers, allowing for explosive plays and unexpected threats to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck includes a mix of disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, as well as card draw and recursion through Unexpected Windfall and Valakut Awakening. The key is to set up the right board state to maximize the potential of Indomitable Creativity and take control of the game with big creatures or game-changing planeswalker abilities.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost creatures and efficient mana usage. By utilizing cards like Ornithopter and Burning-Tree Emissary to quickly build a board presence, combined with cards like Sacred Foundry to ensure mana consistency, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early on and maintain board control. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Venerated Loxodon and Throne of the God-Pharaoh allow for additional burst damage and graveyard recursion in case the game goes longer. Ultimately, the deck aims to win through aggressive and efficient combat strategies.
